periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate tapering toward the lower interior quadrant, creating a teardrop-like appearance.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve at the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick, encompassing approximately one-third of the visible torso length at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separated by a distance approximately equal to 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with a perfectly rounded convex top boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The white fur on the posterior torso and hindquarters displays a beige/yellowish tint compared to the bright white fur of the head.
